record.label: R40 physical compute / economic falsification
record.summary: The exact c142 R40 schedule and tiny tensor identity pass, but the unchanged-raw route is economically closed. With cap512, strict fused physical arithmetic totals 749,925,597,823 FLOPs, 176,109,214,432 above the live 573,816,383,391 boundary. Even the strongest conditional fused/free-forward floor is 582,698,554,603, still 8,882,171,212 high.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed at the current unchanged-raw boundary. Reopen only if an exact carrier/transform primitive removes more than 8,882,171,212 FLOPs even under the free-forward floor, or a measured raw gain raises the lawful compute threshold.
